description: Read-only Application Inbox / Status Monitor for Chief OS v1. Ingests application and recruiter status signals from a local, owner-provided mailbox export (and, when the owner configures it, a Gmail read-only API adapter), classifies them, reconciles them conservatively against the canonical Career Ops regional workbooks, and writes an idempotent LOCAL status store of PROPOSED state changes plus owner actions. It never sends, replies, forwards, archives, deletes, labels or marks anything read, and it never writes to a canonical workbook.

classification.note: Deterministic phrase matching over the message subject + body with email quoting removed. No model is involved and nothing is inferred beyond a recorded phrase match. 'strong' patterns are explicit status statements; 'weak' patterns are contextual and never decide a classification on their own.

rejection.label: Application rejected / not progressed
patterns: we have decided not to progress
not to proceed with your application
we are unable to offer you
will not be moving forward with your application
we have decided to move forward with other candidates

offer.label: Offer
patterns: we are pleased to offer you
pleased to offer you the position
we would like to offer you the role

interview_invite.label: Interview invitation
patterns: book a time for your interview
invite you to a video interview
would like to discuss your application

assessment_invite.label: Assessment / test invitation
patterns: invite you to complete an assessment

follow_up_request.label: Employer asked for something
patterns: proof of your right to work

recruiter_outreach.label: Recruiter outreach (no application implied)
patterns: an opportunity that might interest you

status_map.note: Signal kind -> the region's OWN application-status vocabulary, taken verbatim from regional_profiles.json validations. 'null' means the region's tracker has no accurate equivalent, so no status is proposed and the owner decides. Nothing outside these vocabularies is ever proposed.

pre_application_states.note: A status that means the owner has not yet told the tracker an application was made. A signal that implies an application therefore requires explicit owner confirmation before any state is proposed as confirmed.

matching.note: Conservative, evidence-only matching. A posting URL that appears verbatim in the message and in a canonical row is the only high-confidence basis. Company+title agreement is medium: `title_overlap_threshold` is the share of the canonical title's significant words that must appear in the message. A company-only agreement is ALWAYS ambiguous and goes to human review; unmatched signals never create a record. Known limitation: a canonical id of fewer than three characters (UK J1..J9) can never be matched by reference and must be matched by posting URL.

owner_action_kinds.interview_invite: Respond to the interview invitation and book a slot — this monitor never replies.
owner_action_kinds.assessment_invite: Complete or schedule the assessment before its stated deadline (if any) — this monitor never replies.
owner_action_kinds.offer: Review the offer and reply directly — this monitor never replies.
owner_action_kinds.follow_up_request: Send the information the employer requested — this monitor never replies.
owner_action_kinds.rejection: No reply required. Confirm the rejection in the tracker and close the row if appropriate.
owner_action_kinds.application_acknowledgement: Confirm the application in the tracker (status proposal below) — no reply required.
owner_action_kinds.recruiter_outreach: Decide whether to respond. This is outreach, not an application; no tracker row is proposed unless you already have one.
owner_action_kinds.unknown: Read this message yourself: it could not be classified from its text. Nothing was recorded as application state.

external_action_policy: Every mailbox mutation and every outbound message is OWNER-GATED. This monitor implements no path that performs one: it reads (or is handed) messages and records proposals. Refusals are logged.

local_mailbox.description: Owner-provided local mailbox export. Supported: .eml, .mbox, .json/.jsonl (generic message records or Gmail API message objects), .csv, .md/.txt.

gmail_readonly.description: Read-only Gmail API adapter. DISABLED until the owner completes the OAuth step. Read-only scope only; the API path is implemented but has never been executed on this machine because no credentials exist (reported truthfully as UNVERIFIED, never as working).

not_performed: Any send, reply, forward, archive, delete, move, label, mark-read or unsubscribe action
Any Gmail/IMAP login or OAuth flow initiated by automation
Any write to a canonical regional workbook (Excel remains authoritative)
Any creation of an application record from a message alone
Any inference of employer, title, location, salary, clearance or eligibility that the message does not state
